symptom: `report architecture` shows the whole app (14 modules) as one domain cycle
cause: The catalog gained the `snippet_call` ref kind after the report's navigation-kind list was written; four pages placing another module's snippet became domain dependencies
insight: A hand-maintained list of ref kinds goes stale when the catalog adds a kind. Dropping the snippet-only edges left exactly the two real cycles the hand-made report had, which is what settled it
